response.rationale: Both language answers correctly express “nighttime,” and the English cue and sense are aligned. There is no false-friend issue. However, “different-common-word” overstates the contrast: both expressions share the common word “malam,” and Malay also independently uses “malam” for nighttime. The distinction is better characterized as different phrasing or modifier preference, not different core words.
